about: The cases of the tier rule of podrunner (crates/podrunner-tier). Each row gives the trust lists (config: the keys of [trust] of podrunner.toml), the tier of the set that delivered the job (set), the facts of the job (trust_inputs of job-offer.v1) and the result (expect): the tier that the job runs under, or the code of the refusal. A rule passes when it gives expect for each row.
